references.text: The ark was also built with specific measurements in cubits, demonstrating the precise manner in which God gave instructions for the construction of the tabernacle.
The previous verse introduces the planks (קְרָשִׁים) of acacia wood for which this verse provides the dimensions.
Continues the description of the planks with instructions about the pegs that were to fasten them together.
The parallel passage describing the actual execution of these measurements when the tabernacle was built—ten cubits long and a half-cubit wide.
Solomon's temple was also built with exact dimensions, continuing the tradition of precise measurements for God's sanctuary.
This verse shows the structural connection that holds the individual planks from the source passage together as one unit.
This verse completes the source passage by describing the number and foundation of the same planks.
